rule.name: Codex Discipline
rule.text: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

enhancements.name: Standard of the Emperor Ascendant
enhancements.text: ANCIENT model only. +1 OC and Ld, Feel No Pain 5+. Once per battle, when selected to fight, its melee attacks get +1 A until end of phase.

enhancements.name: Laurels of Triumph
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Melee attacks get +1 S and AP. If assault doctrine is active for the unit, +2 S and AP instead.

enhancements.name: Adept of the Codex
enhancements.text: CAPTAIN model only. Tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine.

enhancements.name: Artificer Armour
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. 2+ Sv and Feel No Pain 5+.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks targeting your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: A WORTHY DEATH
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: When a model is destroyed and the unit has not fought this phase, roll D6; on 4+ the model stays until the unit fights or the phase ends.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF ANGELS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Melee attacks have [Lance].

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one combat doctrine, active for that unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

stratagems.name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

rule.name: Assault Mastery
rule.text: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

enhancements.name: Imperium's Sword
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Gains a melee weapon: A 6, WS 2+, S 7, AP -3, D 3.

enhancements.name: Furious Assault
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit only (UPGRADE, 10 pts). Melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks targeting your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: GENE-WROUGHT MIGHT
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Melee attacks have [Lance]; if assault doctrine is active, [Lance] and +1 AP instead.

stratagems.name: DUTY IN DEATH
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: When a model is destroyed and the unit has not fought this phase, roll D6 (+1 if assault doctrine active); on 4+ the model stays until the unit fights or the phase ends.

rule.name: Tactical Mastery
rule.text: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

enhancements.name: Laurels of Vigilance
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle round per army, Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention on a friendly BATTLELINE unit within 12" costs 1 less CP.

enhancements.name: Tactical Insight
enhancements.text: CAPTAIN model only. Tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks targeting your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: DOMINATION FIRE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit; it is suppressed until the start of your next turn and its attacks have -1 to hit.

stratagems.name: MASTERFUL TACTICS
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" if tactical doctrine is active.

rule.name: Devastator Mastery
rule.text: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

enhancements.name: Master-forged Firearms
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED model only. Ranged attacks (excluding [Psychic]) have +1 A, S, AP and D.

enhancements.name: Honour of Vigilance
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits]. If devastator doctrine is active, the unit can re-roll advance rolls.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks targeting your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: STORM OF FIRE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover]; if devastator doctrine is active, also +1 AP.

stratagems.name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot and destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but can only target that enemy unit.

rule.name: Death Blow
rule.text: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR units have +1 to charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Champion of the First Company
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. Melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

enhancements.name: Corporeum Reliquary
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks targeting your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: MERCILESS VETERANS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits] and [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: GUNSHIP EXTRACTION
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

rule.name: Wrath of the Chapter
rule.text: Friendly TACTICUS units can re-roll advance rolls.

enhancements.name: Martial Paragon
enhancements.text: TACTICUS model only. Attacks can re-roll one hit roll and one wound roll.

enhancements.name: Spearpoint War Leader
enhancements.text: TACTICUS model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle], or [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One friendly TACTICUS unit within range of an objective and eligible to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FOCUS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
stratagems.effect: It can move up to D3+3" when consolidating.

rule.name: Codex Fire-patterns
rule.text: Friendly TACTICUS units' [Rapid Fire] attacks get the Rapid Fire bonus against units up to the attack's maximum range.

enhancements.name: Cyber-familiar
enhancements.text: TACTICUS model only. After both armies deploy, redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY units into strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
enhancements.text: TACTICUS model only. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" can re-roll leadership rolls.

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR!
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly TACTICUS unit within range of an objective.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until end of turn.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle], or [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged TACTICUS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks (excluding [Blast]) have [Close-Quarters] and [Ignores Cover].

rule.name: Shadow Masters
rule.text: After a friendly PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit shoots, either those attacks don't stop it being hidden, or it can make a normal move of up to D6" and cannot declare a charge this turn.

enhancements.name: Venator Omni-auspex
enhancements.text: PHOBOS model only. Attacks vs hidden units re-roll wound rolls of 1; if assault doctrine is active, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

enhancements.name: Execute and Redeploy
enhancements.text: PHOBOS model only. After shooting, if unengaged, may make a normal move of up to 6"; it cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Attacks have +1 S and [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: MORTIS SNARES
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: If it controls an objective, the objective is snared; when an enemy ends a move within range, roll D6, on 2+ it suffers D6 mortal wounds, then the snare ends.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.when: End of opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

rule.name: Vanguard Ambushers
rule.text: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly PHOBOS unit is hidden, its attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until end of turn.

enhancements.name: Seal of Shrouding
enhancements.text: PHOBOS model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting.

enhancements.name: Venator Omni-auspex
enhancements.text: PHOBOS model only. Attacks vs hidden units re-roll wound rolls of 1; if assault doctrine is active, re-roll wound rolls of 1-2.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Attacks have +1 S and [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN REACTIONS
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PHOBOS unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" if tactical doctrine is active.

stratagems.name: UMBRAL EVASION
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PHOBOS unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks targeting your unit have -1 to hit.

rule.name: Walking Fortress
rule.text: In a turn a friendly GRAVIS unit made a normal move, its ranged attacks do not have [Heavy] and have +1 to hit.

enhancements.name: Indefatigable Fortitude
enhancements.text: GRAVIS model only. Attacks targeting this unit with S greater than its T have -1 to wound.

enhancements.name: Relentless Advance
enhancements.text: GRAVIS model only. This unit has Scouts 5".

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: PURGATION PUSH
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: If unengaged, make a normal move of up to 5" ending within range of an objective; it cannot declare a charge or embark this turn.

stratagems.name: ARMOURED IMPACT
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.effect: Select one engaged enemy unit; roll D6 per engaged model, each 3+ inflicts 1 mortal wound.

rule.name: Indomitable Defence
rule.text: While a friendly GRAVIS unit is within range of an objective, attacks targeting it with S greater than its T have -1 to wound.

enhancements.name: Immovable Conquerors
enhancements.text: GRAVIS unit only (UPGRADE, 15 pts). This unit has +1 OC.

enhancements.name: Narthecis Gauntlet
enhancements.text: APOTHECARY BIOLOGIS model only (20 pts). In your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: STAND UNYIELDING
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective it controls; that objective becomes secured.

stratagems.name: SUPPRESSION VOLLEYS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit; it makes a battle-shock roll with -1.

rule.name: Lightning-fast Strike
rule.text: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units have +2" M.

enhancements.name: Supercharged Engines
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit only (UPGRADE, 10 pts). Can re-roll advance rolls.

enhancements.name: Auspex Triangulation Shrines
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES SPEEDER unit only (UPGRADE, 10 pts). At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12"; it is spotted.

stratagems.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: If unengaged, make a normal move; if engaged, make a fall-back move.

stratagems.name: SUDDEN ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit is selected to advance.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can change its advance roll to a 6.

stratagems.name: HURTLING TARGETS
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks targeting your unit have -1 to hit.

rule.name: Enduring Vengeance
rule.text: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Artificer Sarcophagus
enhancements.text: DREADNOUGHT unit only (UPGRADE, 40 pts). Attacks targeting this unit have -1 D.

enhancements.name: Venerable Champion (Aura)
enhancements.text: DREADNOUGHT unit only (UPGRADE, 30 pts). While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is within 6", it can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: ADAMANTINE TERROR
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll with -1.

stratagems.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Attacks have [Lethal Hits], or [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: UPSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

rule.name: Combined Deployment
rule.text: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit; it is assailed until end of turn, and ADEPTUS ASTARTES units that disembarked this turn targeting it get [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.name: Linebreaker Onslaught
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only (20 pts). If it disembarked this turn, it can re-roll charge rolls and enemies cannot target it with snap shooting.

enhancements.name: Damocles-class Uplink
enhancements.text: CAPTAIN model only (15 pts). In your Movement phase, if embarked, select a friendly INFANTRY unit within 6" of the transport and one combat doctrine; that doctrine is active for it.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked in a TRANSPORT is selected to move.
stratagems.effect: While making that move, each model can be set up within the set-up distance of the TRANSPORT, not wholly within it.

stratagems.name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit eligible to fight, wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT and eligible to embark.
stratagems.effect: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: STORM AND SECURE
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit with an ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit embarked.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective it controls; it becomes secured.

rule.name: Ironstorm Auto-targeters
rule.text: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE units (excluding WALKER) can re-roll one hit roll and one wound roll with ranged attacks.

enhancements.name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit only (excl. DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER) (UPGRADE, 25 pts). 5+ InSv; heals 1 wound at the end of your Command phase.

enhancements.name: Gunnery Honours
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit only (excl. DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER) (UPGRADE, 15 pts). Ranged attacks have [Heavy].

stratagems.name: LAYERED CERAMITE
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excl. DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER).
stratagems.effect: Until your next Command phase, ignore modifiers to M, BS, hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: HEADHUNTER DOCTRINE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excl. DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER) is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

rule.name: Purge and Sanctify
rule.text: When a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD makes a surge move, instead of a surge target you can select the closest objective; each model must end the move as close as possible to it. Army may include only BLACK TEMPLARS ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

enhancements.name: Righteous Fervour
enhancements.text: CRUSADER SQUAD unit only (UPGRADE, 15 pts). Can re-roll Advance rolls.

enhancements.name: Oathbound Exemplar
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit only (10 pts). Advance or fall-back moves do not stop it starting an action.

stratagems.name: DOCTRINAL FLEXIBILITY
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one combat doctrine, active for that unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: ANGELS DEFIANT
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks targeting your unit with S greater than its T have -1 to wound.

stratagems.name: AVOWED DESTRUCTION
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Melee attacks have [Lethal Hits], or [Sustained Hits 1].

rule.name: Faith-fuelled Resolve
rule.text: In the Fight phase, if a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD is within range of an objective, its melee attacks have +1 A. Army may include only BLACK TEMPLARS ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

enhancements.name: Fervent Exemplars
enhancements.text: SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit only (UPGRADE, 10 pts). +1 to charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Inheritors of Sigismund
enhancements.text: SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit only (UPGRADE, 15 pts). Fights First.

stratagems.name: SLAYERS OF ABOMINATIONS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Melee attacks targeting a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.

stratagems.name: UNSPARING EXECUTION
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, when a unit engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD is selected to fall back.
stratagems.effect: The enemy unit must use desperate escape, with -1 to hazard rolls if battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: BLADE OF DETESTATION
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.effect: Select one engaged enemy unit; roll D6 per engaged model, each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound (max 6).

rule.name: Templar Vows
rule.text: At the start of the first battle round, select one Vow, active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units until end of battle: Abhor the Witch, Accept Any Challenge, or Uphold the Honour of the Emperor. Army may include only BLACK TEMPLARS ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

enhancements.name: Augury Servo-host
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only (20 pts). In your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 18"; it cannot benefit from cover.

enhancements.name: Consecrating Aura
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only (20 pts). 5+ InSv.

enhancements.name: Incendiary Animus
enhancements.text: CHAPLAIN/JUDICIAR model only (25 pts). Melee attacks have +1 S.

armyRules.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRules.text: At the start of your Command phase, select one combat doctrine, active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with it until your next Command phase. Each doctrine can be selected once per battle unless stated otherwise.

armyRules.name: Transhuman Strategist
armyRules.text: At the start of each battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

armyRules.name: Space Marine Chapters
armyRules.text: An ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit with a second Faction keyword is from that Chapter. Your army cannot include units from more than one Chapter.

armyRules.name: Heirs of Sigismund
armyRules.text: Your army cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER models, or the Codex: Space Marines datasheets Gladiator Lancer, Gladiator Reaper, Gladiator Valiant, Impulsor, Repulsor and Repulsor Executioner.

rule.name: Storm-swift Onslaught
rule.text: Select assault or tactical doctrine one extra time per battle. ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units: +1 to advance rolls. SUBODEN KHAN units: at end of Fight phase, if eligible to fight, make a normal move if unengaged, or a fall-back move if engaged. No ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from other Chapters.

enhancements.name: Stormseer's Wisdom
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

enhancements.name: Chogorian Huntmaster
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit only. When selected to make an ingress move, treat the current battle round number as one higher.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Eye
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit's ranged attacks have IGNORES COVER and SUSTAINED HITS 1.

enhancements.name: Spearpoint Paragon
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Melee attacks gain +1 S and AP, or +2 S and AP if this unit made a charge move this turn.

stratagems.name: EVASIVE MANOEUVERS
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks targeting your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: MOBILE LETHALITY
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to make an advance or fall-back move.
stratagems.effect: Its fall-back move doesn't prevent shooting eligibility. Its ranged attacks have ASSAULT.

stratagems.name: FLAWLESS RIDERS
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: SPEAR THRUST AND SABRE SWING
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Melee attacks have LETHAL HITS, or LANCE. If MOUNTED, they have both.

stratagems.name: WITHDRAW AND REGROUP
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: HUNTER'S INSTINCTS
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

abilities.name: Righteous Zeal
abilities.text: After an enemy unit shoots in your opponent's Shooting phase, if those attacks destroy a model in this unit, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

abilities.name: Exploit their Cowardice
abilities.text: In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit engaged with this unit ends a fall-back move, if this unit is unengaged it can make a normal move of up to 6".

abilities.name: Temple Relics
abilities.text: At the start of your Command phase, if this unit has any Cenobyte Servitor models, select up to one Temple Relic. Until your next Command phase, this model has that ability.

abilities.name: Faithful Cenobytes
abilities.text: If the Chaplain Grimaldus model is destroyed, the unit's remaining Cenobyte Servitor models are also destroyed. Each Cenobyte Servitor takes up 0 transport capacity.

abilities.name: Litanies of the Devout
abilities.text: This unit's melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

abilities.name: Banner of the Emperor Victorious
abilities.text: This unit gets +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.

abilities.name: Column from the Major Altar
abilities.text: This unit has +1 T.

abilities.name: Water from the Stoup of Elucidation
abilities.text: This unit's melee attacks have +1 AP.

abilities.name: High Marshal
abilities.text: At the start of the Fight phase, pick one enemy unit engaged with this unit and roll a D6. On 2-3 it suffers D3 mortal wounds; on 4-5, 3 mortal wounds; on 6+, D3+3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Crusade of Wrath
abilities.text: This unit's melee attacks gain +1 A and +1 S.

abilities.name: Vehement Aggression
abilities.text: In the Fight phase, when selected to fight, make a leadership roll. Melee attacks re-roll hit rolls of 1. If the roll succeeds, they also re-roll wound rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Martial Honour
abilities.text: Once per battle per unit: if this unit's melee attacks destroyed an enemy unit this phase, this model gets +5 OC until the end of the battle.

abilities.name: Vengeful Exhortation
abilities.text: In the Fight phase, when a model in this unit is destroyed and the unit hasn't fought this phase, roll a D6. On a 4+, the model stays and is removed after the unit fights or at phase end.

abilities.name: Remorseless Persecution
abilities.text: In your Movement phase, when this unit advances, that advance does not stop it declaring a charge.

abilities.name: Condemnatory Annihilation
abilities.text: After this unit fights, if it destroyed an enemy model that phase, each enemy unit engaged with it makes a battle-shock roll with -1.

abilities.name: Inspirational Exemplar
abilities.text: This unit's melee attacks get +1 to hit.

abilities.name: Pious Fervour
abilities.text: When this unit is selected to fight you can use this ability: its melee attacks get +1 A for each enemy unit within 6", to a maximum of +3 A.

abilities.name: Armour of Faith
abilities.text: Attacks allocated to this model get -1 D.

abilities.name: Chosen of the Emperor
abilities.text: Your army can include only one EMPEROR'S CHAMPION unit.

abilities.name: Sigismund's Heir
abilities.text: This unit gets +1 to its charge rolls.

abilities.name: Combat Embarkation
abilities.text: In your opponent's Charge phase, after an enemy unit selects charge targets, one unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES target unit with every model within 3" of this TRANSPORT can embark. The enemy unit then reselects its charge targets.

abilities.name: Executioner
abilities.text: Ranged attacks by this unit that target a unit not below half-strength get +1 to hit.

abilities.name: Transport
abilities.text: Carries 7 ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY models, but not JUMP PACK models. Each GRAVIS/TERMINATOR model takes the space of 2 models.
